messages:
Maria CSM: Heads up — QBR for Acme next Tue. Need slide handoff + consolidated exec concerns + onboarding gap capture. Can we land a short runbook and action list by EOD tomorrow?
Jamal Patel: On it. I'll own the slide owners and the action tracker. Who's owning the onboarding gap details?
Olivia (AM): I can pull the onboarding checklist + latest usage metrics. Will add a 1-slide summary.
Ryan E: Eng to prepare rollback/readout notes for the integration bump; I'll add a small tech risk slide and a 1-sentence mitigation.
Maria CSM: Thanks. Please capture stakeholder voice — two exec Qs we saw: cost optimization ask & data residency confirmation.
Jamal Patel: Good call. Proposed action items:
• Olivia — add onboarding delta slide + top 3 adoption blockers
• Ryan — tech risk + mitigation one-liner
• Jamal — synthesize exec asks into 2 bullets
• Maria — consolidate and run final review with execs
I'll create the action tracker in the doc and assign.
Olivia (AM): Adding usage charts. Quick Q: do we want to include renewal signal slide (NPS/trend)?
Maria CSM: Yes, short renewal flag matrix. Use green/amber/red, call out next steps for amber.
Jamal Patel: Pushed a stub: https://drive.redwood.acme/qbr-acme (placeholder) — please drop slides there.
Ryan E: FYI — eng might need 24h to validate the load test numbers. I'll flag any changes ASAP.
EBR-Bot: Reminder: QBR rehearsal scheduled Mon 10:00 AM PT — attendees: Maria CSM, Olivia (AM), Jamal Patel, Ryan E, Exec Sponsor
Maria CSM: Can someone capture stakeholders' verbatim feedback during rehearsal? We need exact phrasing for follow-ups.
Olivia (AM): I'll take verbatim notes for the sponsor segment.
Jamal Patel: I'll own post-QBR follow-ups and the 'who does what' table.
Ryan E: I can capture tech follow-ups and estimate effort (S/M/L) inline in the tracker.
Maria CSM: Perfect. Use this code block for quick action-columns in the tracker:
```
Action | Owner | ETA | Priority | Notes
------|-------|-----|----------|------
```
Olivia (AM): Adding that now. :thumbsup: 
Jamal Patel: Planned risk callout: onboarding blocker #2 maps to missing onboarding playbook — recommend immediate enablement session week of next Mon.
Maria CSM: Agree. Add enablement session owner and invite list.
EBR-Bot: Meeting created: Mon 2026-03-30 10:00 PT — link in calendar.
Maria CSM: Great work team — let's close action tracker by EOD Fri. Quick sync tomorrow morning 9:30 AM PT in #customer-success.
Olivia (AM): See you then. :rocket: 
Jamal Patel: Thanks — will update tracker and ping when ready.
Ryan E: Thanks all — will flag any data changes.
Maria CSM: Closing loop — will run final exec dry-run during rehearsal. :white_check_mark:
